# Project screenshots

Place real project screenshots in this directory, then register each image in `src/projectDetails.ts`.

Useful evidence for the NSL-KDD project: a confusion matrix, ROC curve, model comparison table or notebook output. For the hybrid project: real architecture diagrams, experiment outputs or UI screenshots.

Use captions to explain what a screenshot shows. Include the dataset and test split when adding measured scores. Avoid uploading private data, API keys or identifiable network traffic.
